descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Hanezu hagoromo' Orange Hagoromo Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 The "Orange Hagoromo" leafs out as a bright orange in the early spring. The leaves are heavily divided and look like feathers. Older nurserymen refer to this style of leaf as the "sessilifolium" style. This style of leaf gives an interesting and unique texture to a Japanese maple. By late spring it has matured to a bright neon yellow. By mid-summer the leaves have changed to a bright chartreuse green. During the fall, this selection turns bright orange to reds.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Hanezu hagoromo' Orange Hagoromo 日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 "Orange Hagoromo" 早春萌叶时呈鲜亮橙色。 叶片深裂，外观如羽毛。 老一辈苗圃从业者把这种叶型称为 "sessilifolium" 型。 这种叶型赋予日本枫十分有趣且独特的质感。 到晚春时，叶色成熟为明亮的霓虹黄色；至仲夏又转为鲜亮的黄绿色。 秋季时，该品种会转为亮橙色至红色。 'Orange Hagoromo' 预计 10 年可达高 6 英尺、宽 5 英尺。 'Orange Hagoromo' 也被称为 'Hanezu' 或 'Hanezu Hagoromo'。 这是一株极具观赏价值的庭园树。
